en: A monochrome vintage street scene showing a quiet, cobbled avenue lined with late‑19th‑century townhouses. A man stands with a bicycle in the middle of the street and a horse‑drawn covered wagon is visible in the distance. The building on the right corner has an ornate façade crowned by an onion‑shaped dome. Over the sky area, printed in red Gothic‑style type, is the caption identifying the location as Pulsnitz and the specific street.
